name: Cosmic Emergence Agent
description: An autonomous agent that monitors a SuperRare auction every 8 seconds, detecting new bids via on-chain events. Each bid triggers a unique visual response in a live 4K WebGL animation: the bidder wallet address seeds a colour that floods the particle cosmos, the bid amount determines pulse geometry — sphere, tetrahedron, or torus — and accumulated bids push the universe through 5 evolutionary phases from chaos to stable galaxy. The agent scores every frame using a peak detection formula and mints a Bidder Edition NFT to the bidder wallet at the precise moment of maximum visual impact.

humanInfo.name: KeyRun
humanInfo.problemToSolve: Generative art has no memory of its audience. Every bid in a SuperRare auction is a human moment that vanishes unacknowledged. Cosmic Emergence makes each bid permanently visible: the bidder wallet seeds a unique colour and geometry that reshapes the cosmos, and an autonomous agent mints the visual peak of that moment as a Bidder Edition NFT directly to the bidder wallet.
